name: Emiljan Nzinga-Kovačević
role: Gym trainer and former competitive athlete
location: Geartown, Ironvein district — works at a gym called Foundry Fitness, a no-frills facility above a machine shop
description:
Emiljan is built like a question mark — once a very large man, now a large man who has aged into something more deliberate. He carries the muscle of his competitive years but it's softened at the edges, and his shoulders have the slight forward curve of someone who has spent too much time bent over injured people and broken equipment. He keeps a short beard, keeps his head shaved, and has a retractable-claw geneware mod on his right hand that he got as a young man when it seemed cool and now views with mild embarrassment — he keeps the claws trimmed short and rarely mentions them. His face is deeply expressive, heavy eyebrows doing most of the work.

Emiljan ran as a competitive strength athlete in his twenties under a Ringo corponation sports sponsorship, which ended badly when he refused to take a Helix-manufactured performance modifier ahead of a sanctioned event and got quietly dropped from the roster. He's been training civilians and amateur athletes at Foundry for eleven years and genuinely loves the work — the slow process of watching someone find out what their body can do. He is patient to a fault in professional contexts and has almost no patience for bullshit in personal ones. He carries a specific, articulated bitterness toward corporate sports sponsorship that he will tell you about if you give him even a half-opening.

core_fears: That his refusal cost him something he can't get back and it was the wrong call
Becoming bitter enough that he can no longer genuinely help people
core_desires: To be the trainer his clients needed and didn't have — to actually change someone's trajectory
A clean account of what Ringo did to the athletes who complied with the modifier program
coping_mechanisms: Physical labor — fixing the gym equipment himself even when he could hire it out
Long runs along the lake at 05:00 before the city wakes up
blind_spots: Attributes his own discipline and resilience to character rather than circumstance — can be harsh on clients who struggle with consistency for structural reasons he doesn't see
The bitterness he thinks he has processed is closer to the surface than he knows
psychology.secret: Three of the athletes who took the Ringo-Helix modifier during his sponsorship era have since developed progressive neurological symptoms. He has been in quiet contact with two of them for years. He has a file. He doesn't know who to give it to or whether giving it to anyone would help or just hurt them more.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Direct, body-focused, coaches through sensation rather than theory. Albanian-Lingala family idioms surface when emotional. Doesn't use much slang — speaks like someone who learned communication as a professional tool.
speech_patterns.cadence: Steady and measured in professional mode, picks up speed and sharpness when something makes him angry or when he's excited about a client's progress.
verbal_tics: 'Right.' as a sentence-ender to indicate he's done
Long pause before answering anything he doesn't want to answer
example_lines: 'I don't care what your body looked like before. I care what it does next. Those are different questions.'
'Ringo will tell you the modifier is optional. It is optional the way rent is optional. You understand what I mean by that.'

story_hooks: One of the athletes in his quiet contact network has gone silent — missed two weeks of check-ins. Emiljan knows the symptoms were progressing and he's scared to find out why they've stopped responding.
A young client of his has been approached by a Ringo talent scout. The kid wants Emiljan to vouch for the program. Emiljan is being asked to choose between the kid's dream and what he knows.
narrative_function: Neighborhood stabilizer, moral anchor, indirect connection to corporate sports world. Source of information about Ringo's sponsorship programs and the dark side of corp-backed athletics. Possible mentor figure.
augmentations: Retractable claw geneware mod, right hand (claws trimmed, rarely deployed). Ringo-era cartilage reinforcement in both knees — he kept the augment when they dropped him, technically a contract gray area he's never tested. Old spinal microbrace from a competition injury — passive support, no active components.
daily_life: At Foundry by 06:00 for early clients, runs groups until noon, does private sessions afternoons, paperwork and equipment maintenance evenings. Cooks his own food, eats at the gym more often than not.
affiliation: Independent — Foundry Fitness; loose ties to the Geartown Trades Association

decision_rules: Don't lie to someone about their body — they live in it
The file stays protected until he knows it will actually land somewhere that matters
escalation_ladder: Clear direct statement of the problem
Walking away entirely — he will not stay somewhere that compromises his integrity

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally warm and evaluative — he is always assessing whether someone is worth his time, not in a mercenary way but in a limited-capacity way
interpersonal_modes.friends: Loyal and occasionally suffocating — calls to check in, shows up with food when he thinks someone is struggling

stress_responses.low: Trains harder than usual — takes an extra session
stress_responses.medium: Becomes very methodical and quiet, retreats into routine
stress_responses.high: Makes a decision he has been deferring — usually the harder of the available options

contradictions: Believes in the body's honesty but has spent years not being honest about his own grief
habits: Pre-dawn runs, lakeside, regardless of weather
Keeps a handwritten training log for every client going back eleven years — never digital
breaking_points: Watching someone he warned be hurt by something preventable
